notes: Demotic free verse from 1928 in polytonic type (pages laid out low, so the y_rel flag fires). The labels match the print throughout, including 'κι᾿', 'ἀπ᾿', the onomatopoeic 'Τικ τικτικτικτικ...' (21) and compounds like 'φτερουγοτρικλίζοντας' (38). The final-sigma flag is wrong: 27 and 31 'μέσ᾽' are elided forms printed that way. The only blemishes are em-dashes labelled as hyphens (35) and a clipped crop on line 32, where only the upper half of the glyphs is visible.
